scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./backend run build && pnpm --filter ./frontend run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter ./backend run lint && pnpm --filter ./frontend run lint
scripts.vm:up: cd deploy && docker compose -f docker-compose.vm.yml up -d --build
scripts.vm:down: cd deploy && docker compose -f docker-compose.vm.yml down
scripts.vm:logs: cd deploy && docker compose -f docker-compose.vm.yml logs -f
